findings.claim: No changed line looks at SuppressSourceGeneration. The edits add a `continue` after the mixed-key MsgPack005 report and guard two Dictionary.Add calls against duplicate keys. That stops crashes (InvalidOperationException on `intKey!.Value`, ArgumentException on a duplicate key) whether or not the flag is set. If the 3.1.1 regression is that suppressed types are skipped or their diagnostics dropped, this change does not restore MsgPack003/004/005/012/015 for them. Yet the new README says the analyzer validates these types.
